fact: The National Identification Registry says the proposed US$54.7 million Build, Operate and Transfer agreement would have OeSD International operate the system for an agreed period to recover its investment, then transfer infrastructure and operations to the Government of Liberia.
The proclamation says the National Identification Registry, set up by 2011 legislation, owns and operates the National Biometric Identification System.

FrontPage Africa reports NIR says the proposed US$54.7 million Build, Operate and Transfer concession with OeSD International includes training and technology transfer to avoid permanent dependence on an external company, while NIR keeps statutory responsibility for administration.
system: National Identification Registry digital ID platform

fact: Under the proposed concession OSD would finance enrolment and card issuance, recover its investment over time and ultimately transfer the system to the government, per the NIR Executive Director.
